gpt.text: Uncle made Teysa baroness of Utvara, and they traveled there by lokopede with Melisk and Crix, while he revealed that he had had Hauc drop the mana bomb, which went awry, creating the Schism and mutating the plague.
Aun Yom was killed and rose again, and his band attacked the lokopede, where Uncle was killed.
Teysa and Melisk brought his corpse into Pivlic's bar, and Uncle became a ghost, joined the Obzedat and watched Teysa through a mirror.
Teysa later discovered that Melisk had been erasing her memory and that Uncle's death and the deal with Niv-Mizzet were Obzedat schemes, and she broke her oath.
